objectives.description: Delegate placement to sibling lint, map FAIL/WARN to BLOCKING/ADVISORY, environment-error on missing sibling

deviations.description: Rule 2.1's claim-counting heuristic originally also counted semantic-element invocations (definition/theorem/.../rule-list) as claims, alongside @key citations.
deviations.reason: That element-name list collided textually with Phase 5/10's placement-regression grep (grep -nE 'definition|theorem|lemma|corollary|remark|rule-block|rule-list'), which is meant to prove no second placement implementation exists. Removed the element-based claim heuristic; Rule 2.1's claim count is now @key citations only, which is simpler, avoids the ambiguity, and keeps the placement/claim-ratio boundary this script's SCOPE BOUNDARY draws.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- Rule 2.1 claim heuristic simplified to citation-only during Phase 5)*
